bar.label: Outcome settings
bar.released: The version is released and cannot be edited: create a new one.

panels.resizeHint: Arrow keys change the width, Home and End set the limit

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.loadFailed: Could not load the inputs of the version
inputs.emptyTitle: The outcome does not depend on inputs
inputs.emptyLead: This version has no inputs that would change the outcome.
inputs.allInert: No input changes the result with the current selection.

example.label: Dataset
example.hint: Changes the names and field values of the example, not the structure of the result.

inert.title: No effect
inert.lead: With the current selection these inputs do not change the result sections. You can still switch them to check.
inert.minor: The result sections stay the same, only details such as file names change. Read by {{count}} rules.

links.title: Result elements linked to the input "{{name}}"

result.announce: Documents in the set: {{active}} of {{total}}, signers: {{signers}}
result.emptyLead: Add a document in the version form and the outcome will appear here.
result.stale: The previous outcome is shown: the new one could not be loaded.

documents.whyUnknown: the reason is not in the response
documents.fallback: No {{lang}} edition: the default language is used

meta.empty: The project has no fields or questionnaires in this combination.
meta.whyUnknown: the reason is not in the response

forms.offBlock: Do not apply in this combination

points.openDocLabel: Show the document "{{name}}" in the Documents section

off.absent: document is not in the set

points.whyUnknown: the reason is not in the response

route.empty: The version has no checkpoints, so there is no route.
route.skippedUnknown: the slot condition is not met
route.mayAddBlock: Can be added when the project is created
route.mayAddLead: The project author will turn these signatures on.
route.warnTitle: No person for a route step

sections.stub: The content of this section arrives in the next slice.

rules.title: Rules and reasons
rules.emptyLead: Pick a document, field, participant, point or route step to see why it is the way it is.
rules.studentHidden: Rules are hidden in the "As a student" mode.
rules.noTerms: No conditions: the rule sets an order.
rules.skippedNote: Not checked: the outcome was decided earlier.

builtin.nda_gate: The NDA rule is built into the engine: a document is switched off when the project has an NDA. It can be moved to the manifest later.
builtin.manuals_gate: The manuals rule is built into the engine: it reads the text of the "Manuals" field. It can be moved to the manifest later.
builtin.presentation_variant: The presentation variant choice is built into the engine. It can be moved to the manifest later.
builtin.builtin_route: The built-in signing order: neither the version nor the point set its own.
builtin.other: The rule is built into the engine and has no file.

chain.title: Rule chain
chain.empty: This element has no rules of its own.
chain.emptyDepends: Its state is changed by the inputs under "What if".
chain.emptyStatic: It does not depend on the inputs.

rules.stepNote: A step's chain is the route order and the decisions about the document and slot pairs of its people.

readers.title: What else this rule decides
readers.lead: Other elements the same decisions talk about.

rules.busy_one: The server is busy, retrying in {{count}} second.
rules.busy_other: The server is busy, retrying in {{count}} seconds.
rules.busyFailed: The server is busy, the reason did not load

impact.unknown: This version has no such input.
impact.inert: This input affects nothing: no section of the outcome changes with it.
impact.noLinks: In this combination the input's decisions are tied to no element. It changes the sections: {{sections}}.

footer.note: A calculation on test data, nothing is sent.

errors.title: Could not get the outcome
errors.versionMissingLead: The workspace has no version {{version}} of the {{template}} template. Pick another one in the version list.
errors.treeFailed: Could not load the workspace tree

drawer.title: Files
drawer.lead: Picking a file opens the Files mode: the editor with the Source and Form tabs.

phone.readOnly: Editing is available on a computer.

checks.scopeTitle: Only which rules apply, not their results
checks.scopeLead: Check results (findings) are not part of the instant calculation: this shows which rules apply to the documents of the set. Findings are visible in the preview.
checks.pythonHint: Python rule: runs only at build time, not part of the instant calculation

off.disabled: the rule is turned off in the check settings
off.no_active_document: no such document in the set ({{documents}})

checks.noneApplicable: No rule applies to the documents of this combination.
checks.unavailableLead: The response came without check rules. Recalculate.
checks.emptyTitle: The version has no check rules
checks.emptyLead: Add check rules in the version's checks form.

part.failedStale: Could not refresh the "{{name}}" section: showing the previous data

branches.variantsEmpty: The documents of this combination have no variants.
branches.variantLang: Unavailable variants exist only for a language other than {{lang}}.
branches.showVariant: Show the result with variant "{{label}}" for "{{name}}"
branches.languageLead: Project language: {{lang}}. A document with no edition in it uses the template's default language.
branches.fallbackEmpty: Every document has an edition in the project language.
branches.unavailableLead: The response came without input details. Recalculate.
branches.emptyTitle: The result does not depend on the inputs
branches.emptyLead: No input changes the set, the participants, the points or the route.

workspace.title: Workspace branch
workspace.folder: A folder workspace without git: there is no branch or base, the result is computed from the working tree.
workspace.compareNote: The same fingerprint on a branch and on the base means the same result. The counts and fingerprints below are per section: compare them by switching "Outcome from" at the top.

scenarios.readOnlyState: Scenarios can be edited only when the result is read from the working tree
scenarios.readOnlyStudent: Scenarios cannot be edited in the "As a student" mode

empty.title: Create the first scenario from the current inputs
empty.lead: A scenario remembers the inputs and the expected result; after a rule edit you see which scenarios drifted. For example:
empty.exampleVkr: Thesis: "NDA and only the programmer's manual"

dialog.createLead: The inputs and the example data set come from the screen.
dialog.duplicateLead: The copy gets a new file name and the same inputs, snapshot and assertions.
dialog.inputsNote_one: {{count}} input goes into the file, the rest use their defaults.
dialog.inputsNote_other: {{count}} inputs go into the file, the rest use their defaults.

fields.name: Name ({{lang}})
fields.nameRequired: Give a name in at least one language
fields.idHint: Latin letters, digits and dashes, for example company-supervisor
fields.idFormat: Lowercase Latin letters and digits with single dashes between them, up to 64 characters
fields.idTaken: A scenario with this file name already exists

versions.customHint: Comma separated; an asterisk stands for any ending, for example 2026.1.*

expect.title: Expected result
expect.snapshot: Remember a snapshot of the result
expect.snapshotHint: A run shows any difference from the snapshot: it catches everything but is noisy after every edit.
expect.refresh: Record the snapshot again from the current result
expect.assertions: Assertions: pointed expectations that survive unrelated edits

assertions.noResult: The result is not loaded yet, so there are no ready assertions.

document_state.absent: Document "{{doc}}" is not in the project

item_active.no: Item "{{doc}}" of point "{{point}}" is not active

route_pair.yes: Signer "{{persona}}" is in the route: document "{{doc}}", slot {{slot}}, point "{{point}}"
route_pair.no: Signer "{{persona}}" is not in the route: document "{{doc}}", slot {{slot}}, point "{{point}}"

failure.title: Could not write the scenario
failure.staleLead: It was edited after you opened it. Refresh to see the current version, or save yours over it.
failure.missingLead: The file was deleted. Refresh the list.
failure.taken: A scenario with this file name already exists.
failure.offline: No connection to the server. The scenario was not written.
failure.server: The server could not write the scenario.
failure.busy: The server is busy calculating, try again in a moment.

panel.brokenTitle: The scenario file cannot be read
panel.passed: The result matches the snapshot and the assertions.
panel.unchecked: The scenario has no snapshot or assertions, it only shows the result.
panel.errorTitle: The scenario does not fit this version
panel.errorLead: The scenario inputs cannot be read on this version.
panel.noRun: The scenario has not been run yet.
panel.overridden: Inputs are changed on the screen: the snapshot is taken from the scenario's own inputs, not the changed ones.
panel.accept: Accept the current result as expected
panel.acceptHint: The new snapshot replaces the previous one. You can undo it within ten seconds.

saveInputs.title: Save the inputs into scenario "{{name}}"
saveInputs.lead: What is changed on the screen goes into the scenario file.
saveInputs.refresh: Update the snapshot for the new inputs
saveInputs.assertions: Assertions stay as they are: the run will show which ones stopped holding.

blocked.released: The version is released and immutable: editing is off.
blocked.state: Only the working tree can be edited: switch the state to Working tree.

confirm.noOutcome: The outcome is not loaded yet, so the number of affected elements is unknown.
confirm.none: In the current combination of inputs the rule decides no outcome element.
confirm.count_one: Affects {{count}} outcome element in the current combination.
confirm.count_other: Affects {{count}} outcome elements in the current combination.
confirm.scope: The number comes from the trace of the shown outcome; the server did not compute other input combinations. A deletion can be undone for 10 seconds, then from the edit history.

notice.driftTitle: The record changed after this edit
notice.driftLead: It was changed outside this screen or by another edit. Undo or redo will overwrite those changes.
notice.staleTitle: The file changed while you were editing
notice.staleLead: The record was reread from disk. Check the value and repeat the edit.
notice.missingTitle: The record is no longer in the manifest
notice.missingLead: The manifest was changed outside this screen. The model was reread; choose the element again.

title.undo: After the undo the outcome changed
title.redo: After the redo the outcome changed

live.saved: The edit is saved, the outcome is being recalculated.
live.delta: The outcome changed: {{added}} added, {{changed}} changed, {{removed}} removed.
